kept.snippet: What is Secureblue? Secureblue is a security-focused Linux desktop and server operating system built from Fedora Atomic Desktop base images and shipped as OCI bootable containers. The immutable, container-based approach means the system image is atomic and verifiable rather than assembled by a package manager.
